invariant.name: shares_backed_by_assets
invariant.informal: Every share must be backed by at least one unit of assets, ensuring the share price never falls below 1 and the vault remains solvent.

rationale: The floor division in `mintedShares = assets * totalShares / totalAssets` always yields mintedShares <= assets, so each deposit adds at least as many assets as shares minted, preserving totalShares <= totalAssets. Violating this would mean shares outnumber assets, allowing redemption of more value than the vault holds.
